map.饱和水汽压 e_s 使用指南: Saturation Vapour Pressure e_s User Guide
map.由气温，按 Magnus 公式 e_s = 6.1094·exp(17.625T: Saturation vapour pressure from the air temperature, using the Magnus formula e_s = 6.1094·exp(17.625T/(T+243.04)).
map.由气温算该温度下的饱和水汽压（Tetens 式）。: Saturation vapour pressure at a given air temperature (Tetens formula).
map.作为相对湿度/露点/绝对湿度的基础量。: Serves as the base quantity for relative humidity, dew point and absolute humidity.
map.蒸散与相变计算用。: Used for evaporation and phase change calculations.
map.：25°C：e_s=6.1078×exp(17.27×25/(25+237.3): At 25°C: e_s = 6.1078×exp(17.27×25/(25+237.3)) ≈ 31.7 hPa; at 30°C it is ≈ 42.4 hPa, so a 5°C rise increases the saturation vapour pressure by about one third.
map.：0°C 时 e_s≈6.1 hPa，20°C≈23.4 hPa，升温使空气持水: At 0°C e_s ≈ 6.1 hPa and at 20°C e_s ≈ 23.4 hPa. Warming raises the air's moisture-holding capacity almost exponentially, which is the root of why it feels more stuffy when hot.
map.经验公式在 0–50°C 精度足够且易算，气象水文常用；更宽温区用 Goff-G: The empirical formula is accurate enough and easy to compute over 0-50°C and is standard in meteorology and hydrology; use Goff-Gratch for a wider temperature range.
map.饱和水汽压和单位？: What is saturation vapour pressure and what units does it use?
map.常用 hPa（毫巴），与 kPa 差 10 倍，混用要换算。: hPa (millibar) is common; it differs from kPa by a factor of 10, so convert when mixing them.
